supporting_observations.claim: From 13:33 through 13:48 UTC, svc-claimsync repeatedly failed authentication from FILE-HD-01 at roughly one-minute intervals. The FILE-HD-01 events show logon type 3 and bad-password substatus 0xc000006a; related domain-controller records also show failed credential validation.

The repeated failures are consistent with a stale ClaimSync job credential after the scheduled 13:30 password rotation: the inventory says the job runs and re-authenticates every minute and must be updated manually, while the observed failures begin at 13:33 and recur at approximately that cadence.

At 14:07 UTC, WS-OHADDAD-01 recorded a use of explicit svc-claimsync credentials by C:\Program Files\Commvault\ContentStore\Base\GxCVD.exe, targeting PROXY-HD-01. This differs from the inventory description of svc-claimsync as a ClaimSync job account on FILE-HD-01 and is not explained by the stated approved software context.
The 14:07 event is an investigative anomaly, but this record alone does not establish that authentication to the proxy succeeded or that the activity was malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show failed authentication attempts and one explicit-credential-use event, but do not include a corresponding successful logon or proxy authentication outcome.
The evidence contains no process execution details, service configuration, or software inventory for Commvault on WS-OHADDAD-01.
The supplied records cover only the stated time window and do not show whether the svc-claimsync credential was updated in the ClaimSync job after rotation.

Whether any of the observed activity was initiated by an unauthorized person or process.
